# Visible Watermark Detection & Removal in MATLAB (classical DIP)

**Status: removal works; fully automatic detection does not meet the targets.** All numbers below come from `results/metrics.csv` (24 synthetic images, regenerated by `run_all`). Tested on MATLAB R2026b with the Image Processing Toolbox.

## 1. Model
`I = (1-a).*J + a.*W`, W white, `a = a0*m` (m = soft glyph coverage). Inversion `J = (I - a.*W)./(1 - a)` keeps real texture; inpainting invents it.

## 2. Pipeline
preprocess/ROI -> evidence map (whiteness consistency of the local top-hat residual toward white, x contrast attenuation; `src/evidenceMap.m`) -> classify (autocorrelation lattice / repeated structures / single) -> detect (`detectPeriodic`, `detectTemplate`, `detectGeneric`) -> refine mask -> M1 `inpaintCoherent`, M2 `inpaintExemplar` (per hole group on a crop), M3 alpha inversion with a0 chosen by edge-cancellation (TV on the mask boundary band) -> blend.

- Oracle mask (exact ground truth): **M3 beats the watermarked baseline by about 15-17 dB in the mask**, mean a0 error 0.032. M1/M2 gain only 2-7 dB.
- Auto mask: mask F1 is **0.08-0.27 for every type**, far below the 0.85 target for tiled text. Whole-image PSNR with the auto mask does **not** reliably beat the baseline, so hard criteria 3 and 5 are **not met**.

## 4. Real images (see `results/comparison_<name>.png`)
- w5 (corner logo, `search_box` hint): text removed, the icon remains (mask covers the text only).
- w4 (7 logos): exactly 7 instances found, but the mask also smears part of the trees; some caption text remains.
- w1, w2 (tiled): classified `single`/false `sparse`; the tiled watermark is **not** removed.
- w3 (bold, `search_box` hint): partial. Hints used: w1/w3 (ROI), w3/w5 and wm* (search_box), listed in `info.json` as `hint_used`.
- wm1-wm8 are extras with no ground truth; wm3 (364) and wm4 (138) report implausible instance counts.

## 5. Why detection fails
A single-image evidence map cannot reliably separate a faint white overlay from natural texture (wood, foliage, snow). Autocorrelation of the evidence/gradient map did not yield a validated lattice on the tiled images. Per-image tuning in `src/` is forbidden, so this is reported as a limitation.

## 6. Adaptations
`criminisiInpaint.m` and the toolbox stand-ins were removed once the Image Processing Toolbox was installed. Statistics Toolbox functions are not used. `niqe/brisque` are not reported for real images.

## 7. Future work
Multi-image watermark estimation (Dekel et al., CVPR 2017 - verify details before citing), learned methods (WDNet, SplitNet), better lattice estimation (phase correlation), a user-drawn ROI step.

## 8. Reproduce
`matlab -batch "run_all"` (preflight, synthetic data, benchmark, real images, tests). Tests: `matlab -batch "setupPaths; r=runtests('tests'); exit(any([r.Failed]))"` -> 10/10 pass. Seed: `cfg.seed = 0`.

## 9. Ethics
Academic demo. Only use on images you own or have rights to.
